description:
As an HMIS administrator, you need to configure a new classification for Emergency Obstetric Care (EmOC) in DHIS2. 

1. Navigate to the Maintenance app -> Organisation Unit section.
2. Create three new 'Organisation Unit Groups':
   - Name: 'CEmOC Facilities' (Short name: 'CEmOC')
   - Name: 'BEmOC Facilities' (Short name: 'BEmOC')
   - Name: 'Non-EmOC Facilities' (Short name: 'Non-EmOC')

3. Assign the following facilities to these groups (search for them in the org unit tree):
   - Assign 'Bo Government Hospital' and 'Kenema Government Hospital' to the 'CEmOC Facilities' group.
   - Assign 'Bandajuma Sowa CHC' and 'Mattru Jong CHC' to the 'BEmOC Facilities' group.
   - Assign 'Ngelehun CHC' and 'Baoma CHC' to the 'Non-EmOC Facilities' group.

4. Create a new 'Organisation Unit Group Set':
   - Name: 'EmOC Capability Level' (Short name: 'EmOC Level')
   - Mark it as a 'Data dimension' (Compulsory)
   - Add the three groups you created (CEmOC, BEmOC, Non-EmOC) as members of this set.

5. Save all configurations.
